name: Dynamic Declarations
description: GoTestBed does not support declaring components dynamically in configureTestingModule via the declarations array. Components must be standalone compiled by go-ngc.
mitigation: Convert components to standalone: true, or compile them beforehand and import them via the imports array.

name: Dynamic Component Overrides
description: GoTestBed does not support overrideTemplate(), overrideComponent(), or overrideDirective() APIs at runtime. All transformations must be resolved at compile time.
mitigation: Use dependency injection provider overrides via overrideProvider(), or compile distinct mock components in separate test suites.

name: Zone-less change detection checkNoChanges checks
description: Direct synchronous mutations of component properties in tests followed by manual detectChanges() can sometimes trigger ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenCheckedError in standard TestBed when running in zone-less mode, while GoTestBed's simpler fixture architecture is more permissive.
mitigation: Use componentRef.setInput() to safely propagate input changes, or dispatch real DOM events (like Event('input')) to let Angular forms process changes naturally.

name: Implicit microtask / macrotask tracking
description: Standard TestBed works with zone.js to track asynchronous tasks (like setTimeout or native Promises) automatically during whenStable(). GoTestBed is zone-less by default and checks isStable, which may require manual triggers or ticks for non-Angular async tasks.
mitigation: Use standard promises, async/await, or manual time mocking (e.g. vi.useFakeTimers()) in Vitest instead of zone-based wait utilities.
